== Analytics reports

// Source: KOB-55633 from PR #987
// https://github.com/kobiton/docs/pull/987

=== New Usage Dashboard report

The Usage Dashboard replaces the Usage Report.

- Available under *Analytics Reports* in Kobiton Portal to organization admins, in the *Usage* category.
- Filter by date range and team.
- Review totals for sessions, minutes, devices used, and active users.
- Review session counts by type and date, and usage statistics for each team.
- See top users and most-used devices ranked by testing minutes, with each user or device listed once and all of its teams shown in the *Team* column.
- Export the dashboard as a CSV file.

// Source: KOB-56405 from PR #942
// https://github.com/kobiton/docs/pull/942

== Clearer fold and unfold icons

The fold and unfold icons in the manual session toolbar and the Session Explorer timeline are easier to recognize at 100% browser zoom.

For details, see xref:manual-testing:device-controls.adoc#_fold_or_unfold_device[Fold or unfold device].

// Source: KOB-56017 from PR #967
// https://github.com/kobiton/docs/pull/967

== Lightning Mode stays on when the Android screen is still

In Android manual sessions, Lightning Mode remains active when the device screen is unchanged, such as while reading a test case or waiting for an app.

// Source: KOB-56007 from PR #963
// https://github.com/kobiton/docs/pull/963

== Lightning Mode stays on after locking an iOS device

In iOS manual sessions, Lightning Mode now remains active when you lock and unlock the device using *Power*. The live view displays the lock screen while the device is locked and returns to the previous screen after unlocking.

If you turn Lightning Mode off and back on during the session, the video stream resumes and the device returns to the home screen.

// Source: KOB-55998 from PR #962
// https://github.com/kobiton/docs/pull/962

== Live view rotates with the iOS device in Lightning Mode

In iOS manual sessions with *Lightning Mode* turned on, the live view rotates to match the device's current orientation.

// Source: KOB-56486 from PR #980
// https://github.com/kobiton/docs/pull/980

== Faster recovery for iOS devices plugged back in during startup

iOS devices on macOS deviceConnect hosts recover quickly when they are unplugged and plugged back in while deviceConnect is still bringing them online.

// Source: KOB-56380 from PR #984
// https://github.com/kobiton/docs/pull/984

== Improved native element searches in iOS Appium automation sessions

In iOS Appium automation sessions, native element searches find app icons on the home screen and elements on iOS system sheets, such as the Wi-Fi sign-in sheet for captive networks. A native element search waits up to 5 seconds for a result.

// Source: KOB-52867 from PR #978
// https://github.com/kobiton/docs/pull/978

== Configurable idle wait in Appium automation sessions

In Appium automation sessions on Android and iOS devices, the `waitForIdleTimeout` capability controls how long each tap or swipe waits for the device to become idle when `kobiton:waitForIdle` is set to `true`. The default is 10 seconds.

For details, see xref:automation-testing:capabilities/available-capabilities.adoc#_waitForIdleTimeout[waitForIdleTimeout].

// Source: KOB-55752 from PR #952
// https://github.com/kobiton/docs/pull/952

== File push and pull commands in Appium automation sessions

Appium automation sessions on Android and iOS devices now support the `mobile: pushFile` and `mobile: pullFile` commands.

Files larger than 100 MB are refused. File push and pull through Kobiton CLI are not subject to this limit.

// Source: KOB-56322 from PR #985
// https://github.com/kobiton/docs/pull/985

== Improved inspector data availability in automation sessions

In iOS and Android automation sessions, inspector data remains available throughout the session, even when an app is slow to start. Steps captured while the app is not responding have no inspector data; later steps show inspector data as expected.

// Source: KOB-55839 from PR #982
// https://github.com/kobiton/docs/pull/982

== iOS app signing details in the Kobiton API

Signing details from the provisioning profile of each iOS app in App Repository are returned with the app version in the Kobiton API v2. A new `signing` object summarizes the provisioning profile type, device coverage, team ID, and the expiration dates of the profile and the latest signing certificate.

Android app versions, and iOS app versions uploaded before this release, return `signing: null`.

// Source: KOB-54411 from PR #955
// https://github.com/kobiton/docs/pull/955
// Source: KOB-54413 from PR #957
// https://github.com/kobiton/docs/pull/957
// Source: KOB-54414 from PR #954
// https://github.com/kobiton/docs/pull/954

== MCP 2026-07-28 improvements

The Kobiton MCP server offers three improvements for AI clients that use the MCP 2026-07-28 specification:

* **Stateless requests:** Clients can connect without an `initialize` handshake. Each request carries its protocol version and client capabilities in the `_meta` field.
* **Change-notification subscriptions:** Clients register change-notification subscriptions through `subscriptions/listen`, which replaces the HTTP GET endpoint and the `resources/subscribe` and `resources/unsubscribe` methods.
* **Per-request logging:** Log messages are sent only for requests that set a log level in the `io.modelcontextprotocol/logLevel` field of `_meta`.

Clients that use earlier MCP versions are unaffected.

// Source: KOB-55447 from PR #960
// https://github.com/kobiton/docs/pull/960

== Offline emulators available in Tidy up

Offline emulators appear in the *Remove unused devices* window, opened from *Tidy up* in *Settings* > *Device Management*.

See xref:device-lab-management:tidy-up-devices.adoc[].

// Source: KOB-56280 from PR #953
// https://github.com/kobiton/docs/pull/953

== Session completion and usage recording

Session completion and usage are recorded for every organization. Previously, these events could fail to be recorded for some organizations, which affected usage and billing data accuracy.

// Source: KOB-56280 from PR #953
// https://github.com/kobiton/docs/pull/953

== Saving text with invalid Unicode characters

Renaming a Test Suite, or saving other text, now succeeds when the text contains an unpaired Unicode surrogate character. The invalid character is stored as the Unicode replacement character (�).

For details on editing a Test Suite, see xref:test-management:test-suites.adoc[Test Suites].
